changelog:
web-artifacts-builder v1.0.0 – Initial public release

- Added shell scripts to streamline initialization (init-artifact.sh) and bundling (bundle-artifact.sh) of web artifacts.
- Modernized and expanded documentation in SKILL.md with step-by-step usage, error handling, troubleshooting, and dependency details.
- Added LICENSE.txt and removed outdated skill-card.md.
- Bundles multi-component HTML artifacts using React, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui, supporting advanced frontend workflows.
- Includes troubleshooting guide and graceful degradation strategies for common issues.
summary: Build elaborate multi-component HTML artifacts using React, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui
